operations.name: Saw Cut Blank
operations.setup_note: Clamp the Ø100 mm bar against a length stop and saw a 22 mm blank. Retain sufficient axial stock for facing both ends and a sacrificial first-operation gripping land.

operations.name: CNC Turn — First End, OD and Bore
operations.setup_note: Chuck the sawn blank externally by a rear sacrificial land, leaving the complete final ring length accessible and the through-drill path clear of the fixture. Rough/finish the front face as an axial process reference, rough the OD before drilling and boring, finish the bore before the OD, then machine the front chamfer and external radius.

operations.name: CNC Turn — Reverse and Finish Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse onto the finished OD in bored soft jaws using low clamping pressure, seating the finished first face against an axial stop. Rough/finish the rear face to final overall length, completely removing the sacrificial land, then machine the rear bore chamfer and external radius.

operations.name: Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the completed ring on a non-marring bench fixture and remove residual burrs without changing the specified chamfers or radii. Break remaining unspecified sharp edges within the 0.5 mm maximum and clean away chips and cutting fluid.

operations.name: Final Dimensional Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect each cleaned ring in its free state after temperature stabilization, avoiding clamping distortion. Verify OD, bore diameter, overall length, both chamfers, both external radii and bore circularity using a qualified rotational measurement method rather than diameter checks alone.

clarifications.question: What processing requirements does PS-135.6 impose on this part?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use this machining-only route for provisional estimating, but hold production release until PS-135.6 is reviewed; revise the route if it requires heat treatment, coating or other special processing.

clarifications.question: Which unit system governs dimensional acceptance?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the supplied metric dimensions and tolerance limits as controlling.

clarifications.question: Which released drawing revision applies to this order?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the supplied routing-view geometry provisionally, with production release held until the applicable revision is confirmed.

clarifications.question: What does the circled F adjacent to the PS-135.6 note signify?
clarifications.suggested_default: Do not infer a manufacturing process from the symbol; retain the shown geometry pending confirmation.

assumptions.text: Cold-drawn bright round bar in the specified mild-steel grade is available. A standard Ø100 mm bar is selected because no tube specification or suitable stocked tube size is supplied; the bore is generated from solid for this ten-piece order.
No heat treatment, coating or other special process is inferred from the unspecified PS-135.6 requirement. The route remains provisional until that specification is reviewed.
No drawing datums are identified. The first finished face and turned OD serve only as manufacturing references, so datum_references remain empty.
The template center-drilling step is omitted because the short blank needs no tailstock support. A self-centering on-axis drill opens the through bore before boring.

The template threading and thread-relief steps are omitted because no threads are present. No functional grooves are added; dedicated groove_od sub-operations use a profiling/grooving tool solely to generate the specified R1.6 external corner forms.

The template part-off step is omitted because individual blanks are saw-cut. Both sawn ends receive actual rough and finish facing passes; the first setup finishes the OD beyond the eventual rear-face position so reversing and facing removes the entire unturned gripping land.

F03 and F04 each represent two end instances: operation 2 produces the front instance and operation 3 produces the rear instance. Their explicit chamfer and radius requirements take precedence over the general sharp-edge break.

Facing sub-operations have empty target lists because the routing view supplies no end-face feature IDs. They establish the axial references and final length; F01 is physically produced by OD turning.

The inspection department has access to a qualified rotational indicator fixture or equivalent method capable of verifying 0.13 mm bore circularity. Simple two-point bore measurements alone are not accepted as circularity verification.
The supplied dimensions govern stock selection and routing. The reported computed mass of 0.89059 kg is not used because it is inconsistent with the approximately 0.305 kg nominal annular geometry.
